# Admizz Education

Study abroad consultancy based in Kathmandu and Bengaluru, helping Nepali
students apply to universities in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, New
Zealand, India, France, Germany, and South Korea — free counselling,
university applications, test prep, and visa guidance.

## Destinations

- [Study in the USA](https://admizzeducation.com/study-in-the-usa): Universities, costs, F-1 visa process, and scholarships for Nepali students applying to the USA.
- [Study in the UK](https://admizzeducation.com/study-in-the-uk): UK universities, course options, student visa process, and post-study work routes.
- [Study in Australia](https://admizzeducation.com/study-in-australia): Australian universities, subclass 500 visa, and living costs for international students.
- [Study in Canada](https://admizzeducation.com/study-in-canada): Canadian universities, student visa requirements, and pathway to permanent residency.
- [Study in New Zealand](https://admizzeducation.com/study-in-newzealand): New Zealand universities, visa requirements, and post-study work rights.
- [Study in South Korea](https://admizzeducation.com/study-in-south-korea): South Korean universities, GKS scholarship, and tech-industry study opportunities.
- [Study in India](https://admizzeducation.com/study-in-india): Indian universities, admission process, and costs for Nepali students.
- [Study in France](https://admizzeducation.com/study-in-france): French universities, Campus France process, and tuition costs.
- [Study in Germany](https://admizzeducation.com/study-in-germany): German universities, low-tuition public education, and visa requirements.

## Nepal-specific guides

- [Study in Canada from Nepal](https://admizzeducation.com/study-in-canada-from-nepal): Canada study visa process specifically for applicants from Nepal.
- [Study in the UK from Nepal](https://admizzeducation.com/study-in-uk-from-nepal): UK student visa process specifically for applicants from Nepal.
- [Study in the USA from Nepal](https://admizzeducation.com/study-in-usa-from-nepal): USA F-1 visa process specifically for applicants from Nepal.
- [Best education consultancy in Nepal](https://admizzeducation.com/best-education-consultancy-in-nepal): What to look for in a study-abroad consultancy and how Admizz helps.
- [Education consultancy in Kathmandu](https://admizzeducation.com/education-consultancy-in-kathmandu): Admizz's Kathmandu office services for study-abroad counselling.
- [Scholarship assistance in Nepal](https://admizzeducation.com/scholarship-assistance-in-nepal): Merit-based and need-based scholarship matching and application support for Nepali students.
- [Visa assistance for study abroad](https://admizzeducation.com/visa-assistance-for-study-abroad): End-to-end student visa support — documents, mock interviews, and application review.
- [Career counseling for international students](https://admizzeducation.com/career-counseling-for-international-students): One-on-one guidance to choose the right country, course, and university based on career goals.
